content:
The v4.21.0 release of Lean is here!

The Lean v4.21.0 release brings multiple new features, bug fixes, improvements to Lake, and groundwork for the module system.

Please read the release notes for details.

Mathlib, Batteries, Aesop, ProofWidgets, and repl are now available for v4.21.0:

  • there is a v4.21.0 tag in each repository if you would like to pin to a commit using this toolchain.
If there's need for a further discussion thread, please continue at #general > v4.21.0-rc3 @ 💬 .
